Frame Manipulation Functions /

JMGetFrameContext

Returns the AWT context associated with a frame. 
struct JMAWTContext* JMGetFrameContext (JMFrameRef frame);
frame
The frame whose AWT context you want to determine.
function result
If successful, the function returns a pointer to the AWT context that owns the frame.
